writing.title: The Music (or Movies) I Like
writing.prompt_cn: 用定语从句(that/which/who)介绍你喜欢的音乐或电影。写清你喜欢哪种、为什么喜欢、它给你什么感受。60词左右。
key_points: 你喜欢哪种音乐/电影(用定语从句:music/movies that...)
你喜欢的歌手/导演(用who:singers who...)
useful_expressions: music that I can dance to
writing.sample: I love music that I can sing along with. I prefer pop songs that have great lyrics, because the words tell a story. My favorite singer is a musician who writes her own songs. When I feel down, music that is happy can cheer me up. When I am tired, smooth music that is quiet helps me relax. Music is a gift that touches my heart, and that is why I love it so much.

scoring.content: 含喜欢的类型/原因/歌手/感受(4分)
